endpoints.title: Set Role Permission
endpoints.description:
Sets permissions for the specified role in this channel.

Channel must be a `TextChannel`.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.

verification.test: roles: create, fetch, edit, permissions, ranks, delete

endpoints.title: Set Default Permission
endpoints.description:
Sets permissions for the default role in this channel.

Channel must be a `Group` or `TextChannel`. A channel synced with its category stops following it: it keeps a copy of the category's permissions and the change applies on top.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.

verification.test: roles: create, fetch, edit, permissions, ranks, delete

endpoints.title: Set Member Permission
endpoints.description:
Sets one member's permissions in this channel, applied after every role (for example a ticket only its author and the staff can see). An empty override (allow 0, deny 0) removes it.

Channel must be a `TextChannel`. Needs Manage Permissions in the channel, a higher rank than the member, and only the permissions you hold yourself.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.

endpoints.title: Sync Permissions With Category
endpoints.description: The channel follows its category's permissions again; its own default and role overrides are cleared. Per-member overrides stay.

endpoints.title: Set Category Role Permission
endpoints.description: Sets a role's permissions for a category. Channels synced with the category use them instead of their own. An empty override removes it.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.
